Settings

On this page
  • App
  • Location
  • Calendar
  • Prayer
  • Alerts
  • General

Open Settings with the sliders button at the top right of any screen (top left in Arabic). The settings are grouped in six tabs: App, Location, Calendar, Prayer, Alerts and General.

Every change is saved at once; there is no Save button. The settings are kept in a file in the app's own data folder (in the browser's storage for the web version) and survive app updates.

App

SettingChoicesDefault
Languageالعربية, English, Same as the deviceSame as the device
Start screenHome, Calendar, Qibla locator, 2D compass, 3D compassHome
Text size− and + in steps of 10%, from 80% to 160%100%
DigitsAutomatic, Eastern Arabic (١٢٣), Western (123)Western (123)
ThemeSystem, Light, DarkSystem
  • Start screen opens the app on the chosen screen. The home screen stays behind it, so the back button still leads home.
  • Digits: Automatic writes Eastern Arabic digits in the Arabic interface and Western digits in the English one.
  • Theme: System follows the light or dark look of your device.

Reset all settings

  1. Tap Reset all settings.
  2. The button changes to Tap again to reset. Tap it within a few seconds to confirm; otherwise nothing happens.

The reset keeps your current place. Everything else returns to its default, including the favourites, the alert choices, your sounds' list, the mosques you added and the map choices.

Make a backup first if you may want your settings back. See Backup and restore.

Location

The current place and how it was set, and the ways to change it:

  • Current place, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, Time zone (with its offset from UTC, for example UTC+3) and Source: Built into the app, From the list, from GPS, From the map, Typed in or From the device time zone.
  • For a place from GPS or typed coordinates, Not this place? offers other named places near the same point.
  • A warning when the place's time zone differs from the device's.
  • Change, Choose on the map, Enter coordinates and Edit by hand.
  • Favourites, with Use and Remove.

See Getting started for the steps.

Alerts

The switch Turn on notifications (on by default), and for each of Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha: At the time, Sound, Reminder before, Reminder sound and Vibrate. Then App sounds and Your sounds. See Alerts and the Athan.
